dataset.mapping_note: Kaggle download held-out Testing folder. Same source the model was trained on, never seen during training.

caveats: Measured on a public mirror of the test data, not a private hold-out set. Some overlap with the checkpoint's original training data cannot be excluded, so this figure may be optimistic.

SAFETY: this module missed 24 of 220 diseased cases (10.9% false-negative rate) on the evaluated sample. Overall accuracy hides this because the non-diseased class dominates. Treat a negative result as non-informative, never as reassurance.

safety.definition: Positive = ['Glioma', 'Meningioma', 'Pituitary']. A false negative is a diseased case predicted as non-diseased.
